name: xtremax
description: Write extreme value analyses in JAX and NumPyro on xtremax — GEV, GPD, Gumbel, Fréchet and Weibull as NumPyro distributions that work in NUTS and SVI, stable densities, quantiles and return levels through ξ = 0, non-stationary return levels, temporal / spatial / spatiotemporal point processes (Poisson, renewal, Hawkes, marked, thinned) as equinox operators and NumPyro likelihoods, and xarray block maxima, thresholds and declustering — instead of hand-rolling EVT formulas, Poisson likelihoods and extraction code.
